description: Cross-module schema mismatch between repository persistence key and wire serializer drops timestamp field.
spec_notes: CustomerRepository and CustomerSerializer must uniformly use created_at_ts integer attribute.

repo_files.models.py:
"""Entity data models."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional


@dataclass
class CustomerProfile:
    customer_id: str
    name: str
    email: str
    tier: str
    created_at_ts: int

tests.test_customer_contract.py:
from repository import CustomerRepository
from service import CustomerService
from models import CustomerProfile


def test_save_and_retrieve_preserves_timestamp():
    repo = CustomerRepository()
    service = CustomerService(repo)
    service.register_customer("c1", "Alice", "alice@example.com", "gold", 1700000000)
    retrieved = repo.find_by_id("c1")
    assert retrieved is not None
    assert retrieved.created_at_ts == 1700000000
    assert retrieved.name == "Alice"


def test_wire_payload_serialization_contract():
    repo = CustomerRepository()
    service = CustomerService(repo)
    service.register_customer("c2", "Bob Smith", "bob@example.com", "platinum", 1700000500)
    wire = service.get_wire_payload("c2")
    assert wire is not None
    assert wire["id"] == "c2"
    assert wire["full_name"] == "Bob Smith"
    assert wire["email_address"] == "bob@example.com"
    assert wire["account_tier"] == "PLATINUM"
    assert wire["created_at_ts"] == 1700000500
    assert isinstance(wire["created_at_ts"], int)


def test_nonexistent_customer_returns_none():
    repo = CustomerRepository()
    service = CustomerService(repo)
    assert service.get_wire_payload("c_missing") is None
    assert repo.find_by_id("c_missing") is None


def test_multiple_customers_isolated_state():
    repo = CustomerRepository()
    service = CustomerService(repo)
    service.register_customer("u1", "User 1", "u1@test.com", "silver", 100)
    service.register_customer("u2", "User 2", "u2@test.com", "bronze", 200)
    w1 = service.get_wire_payload("u1")
    w2 = service.get_wire_payload("u2")
    assert w1["created_at_ts"] == 100
    assert w2["created_at_ts"] == 200


def test_update_profile_overwrites_cleanly():
    repo = CustomerRepository()
    service = CustomerService(repo)
    service.register_customer("u1", "Old Name", "old@test.com", "silver", 100)
    service.register_customer("u1", "New Name", "new@test.com", "gold", 300)
    w = service.get_wire_payload("u1")
    assert w["full_name"] == "New Name"
    assert w["account_tier"] == "GOLD"
    assert w["created_at_ts"] == 300


def test_empty_repository_lookup():
    repo = CustomerRepository()
    assert repo.find_by_id("any") is None
